posts.title: Talk to Your Computer
posts.description: I love computers. I always have. The hardware, the software, the whole deal. Poking around a new OS, writing code, learning how something works under the hood, setting up a new machine, upgrading things. That stuff is fun to me for its own sake, not because it’s productive. Computers are just cool.
